name: Ashen Throne
storyline: Two hundred years ago, seventy-two hours of nuclear war ended the world. The survivors call it The Collapse. What's left of civilization scratches a living from the Wastes — three zones (Frontier, Ashlands, Citadel) divided by NPC factions (Rustborn, Iron Covenant, Reclaimers, Hollow), warring alliances, and the ruined Citadel at the center of it all. Six commanders lead the rebuild: Voss the kinetic vanguard, Reyes the tactician, Spark the electric specialist, Cipher the saboteur, Whisper the scout, Vell the architect. Build a mobile Crawler base, recruit troops, run extraction raids under fog of war, forge alliances, and lay siege to the Citadel's four districts. Closed alpha now at ashenthr.one — browser playable, also runs as a PWA on mobile.
summary: A post-apocalyptic 4X strategy MMO. Build armies, forge alliances, raid the Wastes, lay siege to the Citadel. Mobile Crawler base, alliance warfare, fog-of-war extraction, persistent sieges, player-run economy. Closed alpha now. Browser-playable on desktop and mobile.
